Survival Instant Fail bug?
I was doing a Infested Survival Arbitration when suddenly I was killed and the mission instantly failed even though everything was fine.

Full health, full Scarab Shell. Inaros passive, Last Gasp, and Sacrifice all didn't proc either. Just an instant mission fail after I killed an Arbitration Drone. (Also a pod spawned on top of my body?)
